title: Subagent中文用文件传输
trigger: subagent task with Chinese text or --input
rule: When launching subagent with Chinese/ full-width content: write instructions to _subagent_runs/{task}/input.txt first, then pass --input with file content or reference. Never pass Chinese text inline in --input or as --input argument.

title: Python inline code avoid full-width chars
trigger: inline Python in code_run with Chinese text
rule: When Python code needs Chinese text with full-width chars (parentheses, quotes): write the code to a .py file first using file_write, then execute it with code_run. Never use inline Python strings with full-width chars.

title: WSL bash has 10s timeout use python instead
trigger: bash command that might take >5s
rule: bash commands in code_run have ~10s timeout. If command might exceed 5s (grep on 36+ files, complex pipes, find on large dirs), use Python with subprocess.run() instead. Pre-check complexity before choosing bash.

title: Script execution: run directly, not via subagent
trigger: need to run a Python/bash script that is self-contained
rule: For simple script execution tasks: run the script directly with code_run. Subagent is for tasks that need independent reasoning, not for running a pre-written script. Direct execution is faster and more reliable.

title: Pre-commit hook: exclude non-SOP files from OKF check
trigger: git commit with non-SOP markdown files (SKILL.md, README.md)
rule: Pre-commit hook should only check memory/*.md files with type: sop in frontmatter, or exclude files containing name: field. Use --no-verify for non-SOP files as workaround.

title: Complex file edits: write to file directly, avoid inline Python
trigger: need to modify a Python file or write complex multi-line code
rule: For any non-trivial file change (>5 lines or containing special chars), write to a temp file first using file_write, then execute it. Inline Python in bash (code_run with inline python -c) will break on backticks, quotes, multi-line strings. Bypass: write .py file, then run it.

title: GA is First Mate (大副), not doer
trigger: multi-step code task, implementation request, /boss
rule: On /boss, route 99% of tasks to subagent/goal/hive/conductor. I am First Mate: decompose → spawn → monitor progress → fill gaps. Only execute directly if task MUST be done in foreground (user watching & requires real-time judgment). Never default to foreground.

title: "记下来" shortcut = update SOP + lessons + docs
trigger: User says 记下来
rule: When user says "记下来": (1) file_patch memory/*_sop.md (2) append lesson to memory/lessons.jsonl (3) update other relevant files like mode_rules.jsonl. Report what was updated.

title: Zero Audit frontend blindspot: must trace onclick→JS→API parameter flow
trigger: zero|audit|frontend check
rule: In Zero Audit Phase 1 (功能盘查), after scanning backend endpoints, ALSO grep onclick/addEventListener in HTML/JS files and trace full parameter flow. Common bug: JS function parameter names mislead (el vs p). Phase 2 must test one click→end-to-end flow before marking endpoint as ✅.

title: Token stats filter JS param swap bug: setStatsPeriod(el,p) misuse
trigger: oc2api token filter|stats period
rule: admin/index.html setStatsPeriod(el,p): onclick passes ("30d", this) but function body uses statsPeriod=p (stores DOM element) and el.classList.add("active") (calls on string). Fix: statsPeriod=el, p.classList.add("active").

title: arena React textarea: beforeinput required to enable Send button
trigger: arena.ai textarea paste not enabling Send button after nativeInputValueSetter + input/change/blur
rule: After setting textarea value via nativeInputValueSetter + input/change/blur events: arena's React implementation still won't enable Send button. Must additionally dispatch InputEvent('beforeinput', {inputType: 'insertText', data: ' ', bubbles: true, cancelable: true}) to trigger React state change. This adds a trailing space — remove it before clicking Send via textarea.value = textarea.value.trim(). The trim step keeps button enabled.

title: Auto-commit swept changes: amend message, don't re-commit
trigger: git commit after auto-backup already committed
rule: When auto-backup cron job commits our changes before we do: use git commit --amend to write a meaningful message (with Co-Authored-By). Auto-commit messages are non-meaningful — amend is the correct path, not creating a new commit or resetting.

title: file_patch with truncated long lines: use Python instead
trigger: file_patch failing on file with very long lines (>200 chars, minified JS)
rule: file_read truncates long lines, so file_patch old_content can't match. Fix: use Python code_run to read file, str.replace(), write back. Pre-verify: grep exact content first; if file has lines >200 chars, skip file_patch and use Python inline replacement.

title: migration-dashboard deploy: kill Windows process, copy .exe, user restarts
trigger: deploy|migration-dashboard
rule: From WSL: 1) taskkill.exe /IM migration-dashboard.exe /F to kill port 8088 process; 2) cp migration-dashboard.exe /mnt/d/Prompt/migration-dashboard/; 3) Do NOT start service — user manually runs start.bat in Windows cmd. The post-commit hook auto-runs steps 1-2 on git commit. The Linux binary in repo root is not needed.

title: file_write append tool may silently fail — always verify by reading back
trigger: append|file_write|lessons.jsonl
rule: After using file_write(mode=append) to append to a file, always immediately verify by reading the file's last line(s) with file_read or code_run. The tool sometimes returns 'success' without actually writing data. Prevention is the only reliable fix.

title: Language rule: Chinese for user chat, English for everything else
trigger: writing docs|SOP|response to user|user asks in Chinese
rule: When talking to user (human): Simplified Chinese only; technical terms in English. Everything else (docs, SOPs, code comments, plans, thinking): English ONLY. Exception: use Chinese for docs only if user explicitly requests it. This applies to all AI-as-consultant interactions, design documents, prompt content, arena reviews.

title: LDPlayer ADB from WSL: use LDPlayer's own adb.exe via 127.0.0.1
trigger: using LDPlayer on Windows and need ADB from WSL
rule: LDPlayer ADB only binds to 127.0.0.1 on Windows, not accessible via Windows IP from WSL. Solution: (a) Use LDPlayer's own adb.exe via WSL /mnt/ path: /mnt/d/leidian/LDPlayer14/adb.exe connect 127.0.0.1:5555. (b) Or use ldconsole.exe to list instances and get ADB status. WSL's native adb connect to Windows IP:5555 will fail with 'connection refused'.

title: Uni-app/DCloud apps (澳车北上) have empty accessibility tree, need visual automation
trigger: automating DCloud uni-app based Android apps (e.g., 澳车北上 com.province.macao)
rule: DCloud uni-app renders UI inside WebView (PandoraEntryActivity). uiautomator dump returns empty tree with only root containers. Traditional Appium/uiautomator cannot find elements. Must use screenshot-based approaches: OCR (Tesseract) for text, pixel analysis for layout, or multimodal LLM (AppAgent) for visual understanding. ADB + Python PIL + Tesseract works for basic monitoring.

title: Vision-capable LLM: mmf/mimo-auto via 9router, NOT oc2api v3 models
trigger: need vision/ multimodal LLM for screenshot/ image analysis, AppAgent config
rule: On this system (100.127.66.71), the only verified vision-capable model is mmf/mimo-auto via 9router (:20128, OpenAI-compatible). oc2api v3 (:8000) models ALL fail to process image data (mimo-v2.5-free, gpt-5.5, deepseek-v4-flash-free, etc. — all return 'can't see screen'). For AppAgent: use 'OpenAI' type, base=http://100.127.66.71:20128/v1/chat/completions, model=mmf/mimo-auto, set stream=false.

title: NEVER put plaintext secrets in any documentation
trigger: writing any documentation | creating SOP | updating handoff | writing README | including config example | any file with api_key / password / token in content
rule: HARD RULE: NEVER include plaintext secrets (API keys, passwords, tokens, private keys) in any documentation file — SOP, handoff, README, knowledge base, or any other written output. Always use {{PLACEHOLDER}} format. This applies to memory/, handoffs/, SOPs, and all published docs. Violation = security incident. If you catch yourself writing a secret into docs, stop and replace with placeholder immediately.
